text: The Patriots' nightmare trip to Jacksonville ended in a 35-6 shellacking that left Drake Maye searching for answers after coughing up three turnovers—two interceptions and a lost fumble—in what he characterized as an "unacceptable" offensive performance that demands internal accountability. While Trevor Lawrence carved up New England's defense with three touchdown passes, there were few bright spots beyond Marcus Jones recording his first interception of the season, and the injury situation didn't help matters with tight end Eli Raridon (thigh) and safety Craig Woodson (shoulder) both ruled inactive heading into the game. Second-round linebacker Gabe Jacas, who's been making impact plays early in his rookie campaign, will need to anchor a defense that got thoroughly outmatched, as the Week 3 loss raises mounting questions about whether Maye can turn the corner before the Patriots' situation spirals further.
